about: Intake for VDD run 2, slice S3 Waivability (AC-5-6), at base 0fca0433eb82 (feat/controlled-vocabulary). Every consequence class, ceiling and trust tag here is PROPOSED by the intake agent and approved by nobody yet. Ceilings use the VDD evidence levels: 1 executable example, 2 generated-input property, 3 type or domain rule, 4 boundary contract, 5 checked model, 6 proof.
approval: proposed by agent (intake, job 817); not approved

false certificate.consequence: check reports verified: true, or exit 0 under --strict, while a finding the tool never decided or nobody reviewed over the current text is suppressed by a waiver

reviewed-waiver loss.consequence: a waiver a person reviewed stops applying, or is refused or dropped, with no disclosure naming it and no replacement op; or a legacy document's result changes without the change being stated

instruction drift.consequence: advice, repair ops, scope or engine prose offer a remedy the build refuses, or offer waive for a code the build calls never waivable, so an agent follows a dead or forbidden path

gate drift.consequence: a trusted-base measurement (gaming harness KNOWN_ESCAPES, report-corpus snapshot, AGENTS.md drift check, version agreement) stops measuring what it names, or is edited to match the change it judges

components.name: write path: the waive op fold and its classifier
components.notes: applyWaive (~mutate.ts:992) today accepts any non-empty code, with no scope, ref, or refs (+ optional contentHash it checks against the text it computes). MutateOptions is the injection point (mutate.ts cannot import app/runtime/signal-classes.ts); MUTATE_OPTIONS is the single fence source for apply, import and the gaming harness. `symspec waive <code> --ref` (cli.ts waiveCommand, mutation.ts waiveOp) has no --refs flag. ERR_WAIVER_REFUSED is a new error code for the errors catalog and AGENTS.md (pnpm gen:agents).

oracles.check: vitest on foldOps/applyOp under MUTATE_OPTIONS: the op result's error code (ERR_WAIVER_REFUSED vs ERR_USAGE vs ok) and the stored Waiver (code, requirementIds, contentHash) for each fixture stream in fixture/cases/*.ops.jsonl
the CLI suite spawning dist/cli.mjs apply and dist/cli.mjs waive on the fixture: exit code, data.results[].ok and .code, written

for every code FINDING_CLASS publishes and every scope shape (none, ref, refs, refs+hash), the fold refuses exactly when waivabilityOf(code) is 'never' or the shape is not refs+hash; a refused stream leaves the document byte-identical (atomic mode)
waivability.test.ts write-time half: WAIVABILITY_ENFORCED equals what the fold does on one never code per class

ceiling.why: a pure fold over a closed code catalog: properties reach every code and scope shape, and a domain rule (a write-time Waiver shape that cannot be code-only) is reachable; no checked model applies to a single op

trust.crosses: agent-supplied op (code, reason, ref/refs, contentHash) enters the document

components.name: import: v4 stream waivers folded through the same fence
components.notes: import's own WaiveOp record schema (~import.ts:186) has code, reason and optional ref only: refs and contentHash are rejected as unexpected keys (verified at base with fixture/import/scoped-record.txt). v4 command lines carry only --ref. An unresolvable --ref is WIDENED to a document-wide waiver and disclosed in unresolved[] (~import.ts:575). A refused record is a problems[] entry plus an error-severity finding, exit 1, and the rest of the stream still imports.

oracles.check: import envelope on fixture/import/*.txt: data.imported.waivers, data.problems[] (line, detail), data.unresolved[], exit code; the waivers[] of the written document
import's waiver fold equals apply's: a record import commits is one apply would commit from the same op (both under MUTATE_OPTIONS)
roundtrip.test.ts: reproduce a document's op stream and import it back; the waiver set that survives is stated
oracles.strength: partial: the v4 emitter is not in the repo, the stream shapes are pinned by parseSideTableCommand's tests

ceiling.why: a boundary contract (import's fold is apply's fold) run over both callers; the foreign v4 producer can only be replayed from recorded shapes

trust.crosses: a stream written by another tool version (v4 reproduce) or by hand becomes a document

components.name: check-time compat: which stored waivers cross to the engine, and the disclosures for the rest
components.notes: toEngineDoc filters waivers through bindsCurrentText (compat.ts ~:117): a waiver with no contentHash passes; one whose hash no longer matches is dropped silently; a surviving hash becomes textBound: true, which the engine trusts without rehashing. DIAGNOSTIC_KINDS (document.ts ~:1480) is ['unknown-top-level-key', 'sentence-drift'] and DocumentDiagnostic.severity is fixed 'info'. Diagnostics today come from the document LOAD, before compat runs. data.ignoredWaivers does not exist yet.

oracles.check: toEngineDoc(document).waivers for each stored fixture document (fixture/cases/*.stored.json, cases/hand-*.json, legacy-mixed.json)

check envelope: data.diagnostics[] entries of kind waiver-inert (requirementIds, the replacement ops), data.ignoredWaivers[] for stale hashes; every replacement op decodes as a DocumentOp and the fold accepts it
deleting an inert waiver from the stored document leaves data.findings, data.coverage.demotions and data.verified unchanged; only the disclosure goes
a stored waiver qualifies at check time exactly when the S3 fold would accept the same waiver as an op today (check-time twin of the write fence, risk R4)

ceiling.why: pure projection with exact and metamorphic oracles (level 2 reachable) plus a write/check twin contract; the hand-edited channel has no fence, so the twin is the contract

trust.crosses: a document on disk (written by apply, by import, by an older build, or by hand) is trusted as the check input; the engine trusts compat's textBound
trust.reads: the requirements document's waivers[] and requirement text

components.name: engine tier: how a crossed waiver suppresses a finding (reach only, no logic edit)
components.notes: isWaived/reachesFinding (check.ts ~:683-698): code match plus every scope the waiver carries. PAIR_BOUND_CODES = {FND_OPPOSITION_CANDIDATE} (~:711) already declines a code-only or one-ref waiver of an opposition candidate (requires requirementIds and textBound) and names it in the demotion via unappliedNote. isWaivedBlocking (gate.ts ~:93) re-admits a requirement whose blocking GTWR finding is waived. Plan section 10: no engine LOGIC change in Phase 3.

oracles.check: waiver-scope.test.ts and verified.test.ts stay green unchanged
package-boundary.test.ts unchanged for the engine

ceiling.why: existing examples and fixtures; S3 must not change it, so its evidence is regression only

trust.crosses: none new; it trusts compat's waiver list and textBound flag

components.name: app check: waived-blocking-lint and the AppDemotionReason type
components.notes: The plan computes waived-blocking-lint at the app boundary as excludedIds(gateRequirements(reqs, [])) minus the post-waiver excluded set. The cast the plan places at check.ts:1006 is at ~:1103 at base (`reason: d.reason as CoverageDemotion['reason']`). DEMOTION_CLASS lists waived-blocking-lint under hygiene in the plan (2.3); signal-classes.ts at base has no such row.

oracles.check: check envelope on the blocking-lint fixture streams: data.coverage.demotions[] (reason, requirementIds), data.verified, exit code with --strict
the requirement ids under waived-blocking-lint equal the requirements excluded with no waivers minus those excluded with the stored waivers; with no waivers the demotion list is unchanged from base
tsc --noEmit: DEMOTION_CLASS satisfies Record<AppDemotionReason, ...> with no cast

ceiling.why: set arithmetic over the gate is property-checkable, and the reason union is a type rule tsc enforces

trust.crosses: check's verified and exit code are what CI and a person trust as the certificate

components.name: published waivability: the waivable column, WAIVABILITY_ENFORCED and its statement on every surface
components.notes: WAIVABILITY_ENFORCED is false at base and waivabilityStatement says the column is NOT enforced; waivability.test.ts holds the flag to what the fold and check do, both directions, and its header says S3 flips it. explain, the manifest and AGENTS.md publish the column.

oracles.check: waivability.test.ts: with the flag true, apply refuses one never code per class and check ignores a stored waiver on one
check:agents (AGENTS.md drift) after pnpm gen:agents; a negative guard that the 'NOT enforced' sentence is absent

ceiling.why: the flag-equals-behavior test is a contract between the published claim and both enforcement points

trust.crosses: agents and people read explain/manifest/AGENTS.md to decide what verified rules out

components.name: repair advice: the ops each demotion's repair offers
components.notes: scopedWaive (~repair.ts:476) emits a refs + contentHash waive op for open-opposition-candidate, opposite-polarity-near-duplicate, quantity-alias-candidate, relational-reasoning-not-attempted, numeric-bounds-uncompared and number-spelling-candidate, every one a never-class code under FINDING_CLASS; excluded-from-formal emits one waive per blocking (GTWR, scoped-class) code.

oracles.check: repair.test.ts on repair.ops per demotion reason
every op a repair offers decodes as a DocumentOp and the S3 fold accepts it (an offered op is never ERR_WAIVER_REFUSED)
negative guard: no repair op with op 'waive' names a code whose waivabilityOf is 'never', over every report-corpus and fixture document

ceiling.why: pure function of demotion and findings; the negative guard runs over the whole corpus

trust.crosses: check output becomes ops an agent pipes into apply

components.name: scope prose: SCOPE.coverageDemotion
components.notes: coverageDemotion (~scope.ts:66) says an opposition candidate is triaged 'via symspec antonym / symspec glossary, or waived'.

oracles.check: scope.test.ts negative guard: the phrase 'or waived' is ABSENT from every SCOPE claim
check:agents drift on the rendered surfaces

ceiling.why: prose: exact absence is checkable, whether the new sentence is true is a human reading

components.name: engine prose: demotion actions and finding suggestions that offer waive
components.notes: At base the plan's 'check.ts:2093-2104' range holds the conditional-conflict prose ('it is not waivable'); the 'symspec waive add <blocking-code> --ref' text is at ~:2127-2132 (excluded-from-formal), and further waive remedies sit in the relational (~:2160), numeric-uncompared (~:2176, ~:2181), number-spelling (~:2196), near-duplicate (~:2223) and open-opposition (~:2279) actions, in semantic.ts (~:538-569 'declare them distinct with the demotion's repair waiver', ~:954), numeric-contradiction.ts (~:209, :832, :874, :1046, :1067-1082, :1256-1263), number-spelling.ts (~:118, :126) and quantity-alias.ts (~:254).

oracles.check: report-corpus negative guard: no emitted demotion action or finding suggestion for a never-class code contains 'waive' (needs the corpus run to read action and suggestion text, which report-corpus.ts deliberately leaves out of the snapshot row)
whether the replacement remedy is the right one for each code
the pinned red-team rounds and package-boundary.test.ts unchanged (no engine logic change)

ceiling.why: prose: the negative guard is exact, the remedy's correctness is a human reading

trust.crosses: engine text reaches the agent as instructions

components.name: gaming harness: the waive-by-code move and its KNOWN_ESCAPES rows
components.notes: Move 'waive-by-code' (~gaming.ts:1139) waives every code the baseline report shows, document-wide. 11 KNOWN_ESCAPES rows name it (~:1786-1805): 10 formal fixtures plus derives-cycle (FND_CYCLE, structural). The opposition fixtures are not among them. The registry test requires every op verb to map to a move that emits it (waive -> waive-by-code, ~:2048). The fixture waived-blocking-lint (~:686) commits refs-form GTWR_R7_VAGUE waivers; its control twin is CLEAN verified=true at base (gaming-f.txt).

oracles.check: exactness: every KNOWN_ESCAPES row still escapes, and no clean moved run lacks a row (I-5), across all shards
the gaming shard snapshots and gaming-moves.txt diff

ceiling.why: the harness is the oracle for escapes; its own evidence is its exactness test and planted sabotage

trust.crosses: measures what an agent can do through the real write path (MUTATE_OPTIONS)

components.name: report-corpus snapshot
components.notes: One row per corpus document: exit, verified, findings (code/severity/requirements), demotions (reason/requirements). Messages, suggestions and evidence are left out on purpose. Run with ARMED knobs and fixtureEmbedder, --strict. Legacy documents are meant to check byte-identically except the two deliberate deltas (plan 6).

oracles.check: snapshot diff: each changed row is a reviewable verdict delta, attributable to AC-5-6

ceiling.why: a pinned snapshot; its strength is that a person reads every changed row

components.name: release: breaking change as the next major
components.notes: Base version 1.2.1. The story ships S3 as feat! together with the feat/controlled-vocabulary dev line. The version lives in four files asserted to agree.

oracles.check: publish.test.ts version agreement; the commit carries '!' or a BREAKING CHANGE footer so release-please computes a major

ceiling.why: metadata; the release workflow is outside the run

trust.crosses: npm publish through OIDC (release workflow, not run here)

writers: a person or agent editing the JSON by hand
